# Email draft · Dr. Noura — meeting on the intent parser

To: Dr. Noura (CS 499 supervisor) — address not stored in vault, please fill in
Status: drafted 2026-10-29, **not sent yet** (no email tool available)

---

**Subject:** CS 499 Saut — meeting request: intent parser design

Dear Dr. Noura,

I hope you are doing well. I would like to book a short meeting with you this week or
early next week to decide on the approach for the intent parser of Saut, our Arabic
voice assistant.

Where we stand: the speech-to-text stage is done (Whisper), and I have recorded and
transcribed 50 test commands in Gulf Arabic. The remaining blocker is the intent
parsing layer, and I would value your guidance before I commit to one design.

Would any of these slots work for you?
- Sunday 1 November, any time after 10:00
- Monday 2 November, before 13:00
- Tuesday 3 November, your usual office hours

If none of these suit you, I am happy to adapt to your schedule. In the meeting I
would like to cover: the classification approach (rule-based vs. model-based), how to
handle Gulf dialect variation in the 50-command test set, and a realistic cut of scope
for the prototype demo on 15 November.

Thank you very much for your time.

Best regards,
Sami
Computer Science, level 8 — CS 499 (Graduation Project II)
